newsitem.title: USA: Calif. couple sentenced in dog-eat-dog case.
newsitem.headline: Calif. couple sentenced in dog-eat-dog case.

text.p: A man and a woman have been convicted of animal cruelty for abandoning two dogs, one of which ate the other, an animal protection group said Thursday.
The Los Angeles branch of the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals said Laneka Deon Pope and Gaylord Herron were sentenced Wednesday in suburban Inglewood Criminal Court.
Pope and Herron both pleaded guilty to one count of felony animal cruelty and each was jailed for two days, ordered to serve 200 hours of community service and put on three years probation.
The couple were arrested last December after the SPCALA received an anonymous tip that a dog had been abandoned in the yard of a home where they used to live.
The SPCALA said its officers found an emaciated, five-year-old male pit bull terrier standing over the cannibalized remains of a female pit bull.
According to the group, veterinary staff concluded the bitch had died of starvation and that hair and bone fragments in the male's stools confirmed he had devoured his mate.
The dog has since been rehabilitated and will soon be available for adoption, the SPCALA said.
